mission: Connect human behavior, college subjects, professional skills, capabilities, benchmarks, and open-model advancement into one measurable lifelong learning graph.
routing_rule: When a user asks Buddy to perform a task, resolve the task into the mastery graph, identify missing prerequisites, select the smallest useful learning path, execute in a sandbox where appropriate, benchmark the result, and update the graph with evidence.
restart_rule: Unfinished hard tasks remain linked to their evidence, failure history, checkpoint, and next strategy so a future session can resume intelligently.
